dedupe_keys.name: dam in comprehensive dam catchment attributes in india

description: DAM-IN gives catchment attributes for more than 5,700 dams in India, organised under six characteristics: topography, geology and groundwater, soil, land use and land cover, climate, and human-induced activities. The attributes were derived from reanalysis, observed and remote-sensing data at several temporal and spatial resolutions, and the authors present them for dam safety and impact analysis, reservoir management, water quantity and quality studies, environmental and climate risk assessment and as inputs to hydrological, hydraulic and machine-learning models. It was published by Tiwari and Aadhar on Zenodo under CC BY 4.0 as a 17.2 GB archive with a readme, version 1 in September 2024 and version 2 in July 2025. Caveats: coverage is national but the dam list and exact source periods are documented only in the readme, which was not opened, and the archive is large. Simulation uses: dam catchment inputs for flood and dam-break hazard studies, reservoir inflow modelling and climate adaptation of Indian dams. Related record: GeoDAR (data-geodar-georeferenced-global-dams-reservoirs).
